description: Test suite for binary HTTP message classes in the quiche project, including encoding, decoding, equality, and padding tests for request and response objects.

classes.name: BinaryHttpRequest
classes.description: Represents a binary HTTP request with methods for serialization, header management, and body handling.

classes.name: BinaryHttpResponse
classes.description: Represents a binary HTTP response with methods for serialization, header management, body handling, and informational responses.

methods.name: swap_body
methods.description: Swaps the request or response body with another string.

methods.name: AddHeaderField
methods.description: Adds a header field to the HTTP message.

methods.name: set_body
methods.description: Sets the body content of the HTTP message.

methods.name: Serialize
methods.description: Serializes the HTTP message into a string of bytes.

methods.name: DebugString
methods.description: Returns a human-readable string representation of the message.

methods.name: control_data
methods.description: Returns the control data (method, scheme, authority, path) of the request.

methods.name: GetHeaderFields
methods.description: Returns the list of header fields.

methods.name: AddInformationalResponse
methods.description: Adds an informational response (status code 1xx) with headers.

methods.name: informational_responses
methods.description: Returns the list of informational responses.

methods.name: IsPayloadEqual
methods.description: Checks if the payload of two messages are equal.

methods.name: EncodedSize
methods.description: Returns the size of the serialized message including padding.

methods.name: num_padding_bytes
methods.description: Returns the number of padding bytes added.
